name: Q4_0 quantization-aware training (QUASAR) vs RTN Q4_0 on AMD Strix Halo
description: QUASAR-QAT Q4_0 GGUFs of Qwen3.5-4B, gemma-4-E4B-it, gemma-4-12B-it and Muse-Glimmer-30B against plain round-to-nearest Q4_0 of the same models (bartowski's imatrix files and a --pure imatrix control), measured on one AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395: KL divergence and top-1 agreement vs BF16, prompt and decode tokens per second.
measurementTechnique: llama-perplexity --kl-divergence against a fixed reference; streamed greedy decode timing; GSM8K first 40 of a fixed 200-problem sample, greedy
